# alert-troubleshooter
Observability plumbing (krateo-platformops): an Alert firing (HyperDX webhook or apiRef) -> an
Incident (observability.krateo.io/v1alpha1, incident-controller's CRD) with an incident-agent A2A
root-cause analysis. It calls an agent; it is not one.
Identity: one Alert CR = one HyperDX alert named after its metadata.name; its incidents carry the
label observability.krateo.io/alert=<metadata.name>. The webhook title carries that name.
Policy A: at most one open incident per alert; a firing on it does firings++, else a new
<alert>-<yyyymmdd-hhmmss> opens (Analyzing -> RCA -> Open, error set when it has no howToFix).

docs/overview.md: architecture
docs/usage.md: install + wire the webhook
docs/configuration.md: image + runtime env
docs/api.md: the Alert CRD, the Incident fields written, HTTP surface
report_v2.py: the RCA output contract; howToFix = {precondition, apply, verify} bash scripts, exit 0 gone / 1 holds / else unknown, all three or none
docs/examples.md: runnable examples
docs/release.md: bare-semver build/release
helm/alert-troubleshooter/: the chart
Alert.status.okSince: when the alert last turned OK, unset otherwise; display only.
Alert.status.value: an apiRef alert's last RESTAction number, unset for a where alert; display only.
Alert.spec.apiRef: a RESTAction ({value: N, items?}) polled every interval via snowplow instead of a HyperDX where; needs config.authnUrl.
ClusterRole alert-viewer: get/list/watch on Alerts for portal users (the portal reads with the user's token); shipped with no binding, admins bind it to groups.
